50730039.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PDHK1 (unknown origin) by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. PDHK-1 (10 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and the ligand (100 μM) was loaded into the syringe. The reference cell was filled with buffer. The buffer was 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, 0.01% Tween-20. The stirring speed was 300 rpm. The ligand was injected in 20 successive 2 μL injections, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The binding constant (K), enthalpy (ΔH), and stoichiometry (n) were determined from the fit. The heat of dilution was subtracted from the raw data. The experiments were performed in triplicate, and the data are presented as the mean ± standard deviation.

assay_conditions.control_method: The heat of dilution was subtracted from the raw data
